name: Pechish
indication_description:
Pechish is indicated in-
  • Amoebic dysentery
  • Bacillary dysentery
  • Diarrhoea
  • Gastro-intestinal colic.
pharmacology_description: Pechish is a unique formulation of highly efficacious medicinal plants for amoebic dysentery, bacillary dysentery, diarrhoea & gastro-intestinal colic. The synergistic action of the herbs normalizes the hyper-motility of the digestive system and promptly stops diarrhoea. It is also highly effective to eradicate causative organism (Shigella sp.) of bacillary dysentery.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) 2-3 times daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
